daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a noun genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position [of the genitive] by annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿بَيِّنَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of circumstance. ﴿ما عِنْدِي﴾ mā is negating; ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; ʿinda is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿ما تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar is the adverb ʿindī. The verbal clause tastaʿjilūna is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِ﴾ negating, meaning mā. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); huwa is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْفاصِلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; ʿinda is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of anna [Translator's note: the source skips «أَنَّ» of the verse («لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي») in its quoted words]. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna [Translator's note: so in the source («اسم إن»); the particle in the verse is «أَنَّ»]. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb: "if their hastening were established…"; the clause law and what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي﴾ a passive imperfect verb [Translator's note: so in the source; «قُضِيَ» is a past verb] and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ are attached to it; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَفاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source, which labels the pair this way; mafātiḥu is the postponed mubtadaʾ just mentioned, and al-ghaybi is the muḍāf ilayhi], and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the hāʾ is its object, and lā is negating. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the verb yaʿlamuhā, or it is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما فِي الْبَرِّ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; waraqa is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position because it is the fāʿil of ﴿تَسْقُطُ﴾. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is a ḥāl of waraqa; this is allowed because it is preceded by a negation. ﴿وَلا حَبَّةٍ﴾ conjoined, and lā is negating. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ḥabba. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا رَطْبٍ﴾ conjoined to ḥabba. ﴿وَلا يابِسٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها﴾. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate). ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm is for the plural, and the fāʿil (agent) refers back to the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", and the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَرَحْتُمْ بِالنَّهارِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيُقْضى أَجَلٌ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being a fatḥa implied on the alif; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ﴿يَبْعَثُكُمْ﴾. ﴿أَجَلٌ﴾ the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of ajal. ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ ilayhi: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ marjiʿukum, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it; likewise the clause ﴿ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ after it is conjoined. ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kuntum.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الْقاهِرُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the active participle al-qāhir. ﴿عِبادِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; ḥafaẓa is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾ a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil. ﴿تَوَفَّتْهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the omitted alif; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رُسُلُنا﴾ the fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); hum is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿هُمْ لا يُفَرِّطُونَ﴾ is circumstantial or resumptive.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿ثُمَّ رُدُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنا﴾. ﴿مَوْلاهُمُ﴾ a badal (substitute) of Allāh, genitive like it with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of mawlā, genitive like it with kasra. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; likewise the nominal clause ﴿وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحاسِبِينَ﴾ is resumptive like it.

daas-irab:63-64.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنَجِّيكُمْ مِنْ ظُلُماتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْبَرِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿تَدْعُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object. ﴿تَضَرُّعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَخُفْيَةً﴾ conjoined, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿لَئِنْ أَنْجانا﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); ﴿إن﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿أَنْجانا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa, and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The clause is the object of an omitted saying, its implied form being: "you call upon Him and say: if He saves us"; it may also be inceptive, since it is the conditional clause. ﴿مِنْ هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; nakūnanna is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because of its connection with the nūn of emphasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of in has been omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it, according to the rule: when an oath and a condition come together, the answer belongs to the one that comes first. ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُنَجِّيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَمِنْ كُلِّ﴾ conjoined. ﴿كَرْبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ the mubtadaʾ. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil (agent) is latent, and the nominal clause ﴿هُوَ الْقادِرُ﴾, made up of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أَنْ﴾ and the verb ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by ʿalā. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عَذاباً﴾. ﴿أَوْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object. ﴿شِيَعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾. ﴿وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿بَأْسَ﴾ its second object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and its fāʿil is "you" [Translator's note: so in the source («أنت»); the verb is first person plural, "we"]; the verbal clause stands in place of the two objects of unẓur, and the clause ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla, and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as its noun, and the clause ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as its khabar; the nominal clause laʿallahum yafqahūna is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); qawmuka is its fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive.
﴿لَسْتُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to wakīl. ﴿بِوَكِيلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition in the khabar of lastu; wakīl is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of lastu, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿نَبَإٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَسَوْفَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and sawfa is a particle of the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). The two clauses are resumptive.

daas-irab:68-68.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of condition. ﴿رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and the relative noun its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation after the adverb idhā. ﴿يَخُوضُونَ فِي آياتِنا﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿يَخُوضُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after ḥattā, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by ḥattā, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; likewise ﴿فِي حَدِيثٍ﴾ is attached to the verb yakhūḍū before them. ﴿غَيْرِهِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾ in is a jussive-making conditional particle that makes two imperfect verbs jussive; mā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يُنْسِيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا تَقْعُدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, to which the adverb ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ is attached; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿الذِّكْرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to taqʿud. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an adjective, genitive with yāʾ.

daas-irab:69-69.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) shayʾ. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ حِسابِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of shayʾ, because it has come before it after having been its adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, and the khabar is omitted, the implied form being: "but upon them is a reminder"; this is easier than assuming an omitted verb:
"remind them a reminding". ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar. The nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿وَذَرِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn and given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is "you", and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object, and ﴿لَعِباً﴾ its second object. ﴿وَلَهْواً﴾ conjoined, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَياةُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿أَنْ تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "so that [a soul] is not given up to destruction" (لئلا تبسل). ﴿بِما كَسَبَتْ﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb tubsala, the implied form being "that it be given up to destruction for its earning". ﴿لَيْسَ لَها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb laysa. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of walī or shafīʿ. ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾ the noun of laysa, nominative. ﴿وَلا شَفِيعٌ﴾ conjoined, and the clause of the incomplete verb is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of nafs. ﴿وَإِنْ تَعْدِلْ﴾ in is conditional and taʿdil is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being a latent pronoun. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَدْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْها﴾ the clause of the passive imperfect verb is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; minhā is attached to the verb before it, and lā is negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ or with conditional idhā; the clause in taʿdil is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar. ﴿أُبْسِلُوا﴾ a passive past verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما كَسَبُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar composed of maṣdar-forming mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the clause kasabū is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ شَرابٌ﴾ lahum is attached to a fronted khabar, and sharāb is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ حَمِيمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of sharāb. ﴿وَعَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ʿadhāb or to an omitted adjective: "for them is a punishment for their disbelief". The clause lahum ʿadhābun is a second khabar of the demonstrative ulāʾika.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَدْعُوا مِنْ دُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw because of heaviness, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا يَنْفَعُنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nā is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يَضُرُّنا﴾ conjoined; the clause a-nadʿū is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنُرَدُّ عَلى أَعْقابِنا﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "we", and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿أَنَدْعُوا﴾. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to nuraddu. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿هَدانَا اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كَالَّذِي﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "we are turned back with a turning like the turning of the one whom the devils enticed", and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation; or the kāf is a preposition and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the two are attached to an omitted adjective of the mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّياطِينُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on a fatḥa implied on the omitted alif; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and al-shayāṭīn is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَيْرانَ﴾ a ḥāl. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَصْحابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the verbal clause ﴿يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى الْهُدَى﴾ is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of aṣḥāb. ﴿ائْتِنا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter from its end, because it is weak-final (atā); its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and nā is its object; the clause is the object of the saying of an omitted verb, its implied form being "saying: come to us", and the implied clause is circumstantial; the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ﴾ inna and its noun, and Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْهُدَى﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause ﴿هُوَ الْهُدى﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna; the clause inna hudā Allāhi is the object of the saying. ﴿وَأُمِرْنا﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause inna hudā Allāhi. ﴿لِنُسْلِمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb wa-umirnā: "we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds". ﴿لِرَبِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb nuslima. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar from nuslima and the an before it, the implied form being: "we have been commanded to submit and to establish the prayer".
﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَاتَّقُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; huwa is a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِي﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb after them. ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "He created the heavens, [it being] determined with truth". ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to the omitted verb ﴿اذكر﴾ ("remember"), and the verbal clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", referring to everything Allah created. ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ a complete imperfect verb conjoined to the verb kun before it, and the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, a badal (substitute) of yawma yaqūlu before it, accusative with fatḥa like it. ﴿يُنْفَخُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾ are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عالِمُ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He is the Knower". ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْخَبِيرُ﴾ a second khabar, nominative.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "remember" (اذكر); the wāw is resumptive, so the clause is resumptive, and the verbal clause ﴿قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿آزَرَ﴾ a badal (substitute), genitive with fatḥa in place of kasra because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿أَتَتَّخِذُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿أَصْناماً﴾ its first object. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ its second object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿إِنِّي أَراكَ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿أَراكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is its first object; fī ḍalālin is attached to arāka and the two are the second object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I". ﴿وَقَوْمَكَ﴾ a noun conjoined to the kāf, accusative with fatḥa, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with kasra. The clause arāka is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an implied maṣdar, the implied form being: "We show Ibrāhīm the dominion of the heavens and the earth with a showing like the showing of his father's error"; the wāw before them is parenthetical. ﴿نُرِي إِبْراهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "we"; Ibrāhīm is its first object and malakūt its second object. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلِيَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the incomplete verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to an implied, omitted conjoined element, i.e. "We did that so that he would believe and so that he would be certain". ﴿مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of yakūna. The clause ﴿وَكَذلِكَ نُرِي..﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; lammā is adverbial, of time (ḥīniyya). ﴿جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and al-layl is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿رَأى كَوْكَباً﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to conditional lammā; the clause ﴿قالَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the khabar (predicate), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ﴾ like ﴿فَلَمَّا جَنَّ﴾. The clause ﴿قالَ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿لا أُحِبُّ الْآفِلِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, accusative with yāʾ, and the clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَمَرَ﴾ the i'rab of its like has preceded, and likewise ﴿قالَ هذا رَبِّي فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ قالَ..﴾. ﴿بازِغاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, because raʾā is visual, not mental. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿يَهْدِنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَأَكُونَنَّ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath that preceded the condition, so it stands in place of its apodosis. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb. ﴿الضَّالِّينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with yāʾ.

daas-irab:78-78.t: The i'rab of the beginning of the verse has preceded. ﴿هذا أَكْبَرُ﴾ like hādhā rabbī in the previous verse. ﴿مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ mā: maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ببريء﴾, the implied form being "I am free of your associating"; it may also be a relative noun, i.e. "of those you associate with Allah"; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) on the first view and the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun on the second. [Translator's note: so in the source; on the first view, maṣdar-forming mā and its clause would form a maṣdar rather than an adjective.]

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿وَجَّهْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَجْهِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لِلَّذِي﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿فَطَرَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negating, with no governing effect, or it is the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does. ﴿أَنَا﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ — this on the first view in the i'rab of mā — and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿إِنِّي﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the verbal clause ﴿وَجَّهْتُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وَحاجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَتُحاجُّونِّي﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; tuḥājjūnnī is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the [second] nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿هَدانِ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا أَخافُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, lā is negating, akhāfu is an imperfect verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ يَشاءَ﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ the fāʿil, nominative with a ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb after it is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being: "but my Lord's will, I fear it". ﴿وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and shayʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿عِلْماً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿أَفَلا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; lā is negating, the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive; the clause ﴿تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وَكَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَشْرَكْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and lā is negating; the clause is conjoined, or circumstantial if the wāw before it is circumstantial. ﴿أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُمْ﴾ anna, and the kāf is its noun, and the clause ashraktum is its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them.
﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَيُّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition); ayyu is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْفَرِيقَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ the khabar. ﴿بِالْأَمْنِ﴾ the two are attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) aḥaqq. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ kāna is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun and the clause taʿlamūna is its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: "if you know, then tell me: which of the two parties is more deserving of security?" The clause ayyu al-farīqayni is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause āmanū is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause alladhīna āmanū is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَمْنُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ulāʾika, and the clause ulāʾika lahumu al-amnu is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the relative noun alladhīna. ﴿وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of circumstance. This is if the speech is the speech of Allah the Exalted; if it is the speech of our master Ibrāhīm, the i'rab differs from this, and alladhīna is parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the more deserving of security are those who believed".

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and [tī is] a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿حُجَّتُنا﴾ the khabar (predicate), and nā is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿آتَيْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause wa-tilka ḥujjatunā is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ḥujja. ﴿نَرْفَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾ a ḥāl, accusative with kasra instead of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause narfaʿu is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنا لَهُ إِسْحاقَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent) and al-ḥaqq is its object [Translator's note: so in the source («والحق مفعوله»), evidently for «إسحاق», Isḥāq]. ﴿وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُلًّا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb after it. ﴿هَدَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنُوحاً هَدَيْنا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi, a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "and We guided them, they being of his offspring". And ﴿داوُدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ﴾ are conjoined to Nūḥ. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition; dhā is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "We reward the good-doers with a reward like that reward". ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we"; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-85.t: ﴿وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيى وَعِيسى وَإِلْياسَ﴾ conjoined to Mūsā and Hārūn. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; beginning with an indefinite is permitted because of the implied annexation in it: "and every man of them". ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ a noun genitive with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause ﴿كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ is parenthetical.

daas-irab:86-86.t: ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطاً﴾ conjoined to Ilyās. ﴿وَكلًّا﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿فَضَّلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is conjoined to the clause kullan hadaynā.

daas-irab:87-87.t: ﴿وَمِنْ آبائِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to Dāwūd and Sulaymān, i.e. "and Nūḥ We guided before, and of his offspring Dāwūd and Sulaymān". ﴿وَمِنْ آبائِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ وَإِخْوانِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاجْتَبَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and like it ﴿وَهَدَيْناهُمْ﴾. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ ilā ṣirāṭin: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the two clauses are conjoined to the clause ﴿وَكلًّا فَضَّلْنا﴾.

daas-irab:88-88.t:
﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿هُدَى﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and man is a relative noun, its object. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being of His servants"; the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of hudā Allāh. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ law is a non-jussive conditional particle and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil of ḥabiṭa; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. It is also possible that ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, the maṣdar interpreted from it and the verb after it being in the position of the nominative as fāʿil, the implied form being: "their work would have come to nothing for them".
﴿كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun and the clause yaʿmalūna is its khabar; the clause of the incomplete verb is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, on the parsing of ﴿ما﴾ as a relative noun.

daas-irab:89-89.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, its khabar (predicate). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ﴾ conjoined; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause ulāʾika alladhīna is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and in is a jussive-making conditional particle that makes two imperfect verbs jussive.
﴿يَكْفُرْ بِها هؤُلاءِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the demonstrative hāʾulāʾi is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ [qad is] a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَكَّلْنا بِها قَوْماً﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil and qawman its object, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَيْسُوا بِها بِكافِرِينَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw is its noun; in bi-kāfirīna the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and kāfirīna is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to the active participle ﴿كافرين﴾, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿قَوْماً﴾.

daas-irab:90-90.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), as in the previous verse, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَدَى اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being "Allah guided them". ﴿فَبِهُداهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb iqtadih after them. ﴿اقْتَدِهْ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and the hāʾ is for pausing (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition: "if the matter is as mentioned, then follow them". ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is "you", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is "I"; the kāf is its first object, lā is negating, with no governing effect, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿أَجْراً﴾, and ﴿أَجْراً﴾ is its second object. ﴿إِنْ﴾ the negating in. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ the khabar. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to dhikrā, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَقَّ﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قَدْرِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb qadarū. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, and mā is negating; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلى بَشَرٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; shayʾ is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word in the verse is «مَنْ»] an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause anzala is its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿جاءَ بِهِ مُوسى﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and Mūsā is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿نُوراً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُدىً﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to hudan. ﴿تَجْعَلُونَهُ قَراطِيسَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; qarāṭīsa is a ḥāl, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of al-kitāb. ﴿تُبْدُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of qarāṭīs; the clause ﴿وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيراً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَعُلِّمْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw before it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿آباؤُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to antum; the clause taʿlamū is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the verse has «اللَّهُ»] the Name of Majesty, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: "Allah sent it down"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ذَرْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, the mīm being the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿فِي خَوْضِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them or after them, and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿يَلْعَبُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject); لله: the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām, [the two] attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive as an adjective of الله; and the clause ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُماتِ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾. ﴿ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ the clause كفروا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to كفروا or to يعدلون, i.e. «they set up others as equal to their Lord»; and the clause ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ .. is conjoined to the clause الحمد لله..

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the kāf is its object; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ قَضى أَجَلًا﴾ past verb and its object; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَجَلٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. أجل: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective, nominative with the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَمْتَرُونَ﴾ imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. And the clause أنتم تمترون is conjoined to the clause before it.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its khabar (predicate), nominative. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, by construing it as a derived word (mushtaqq), i.e. «the One worshipped». ﴿وَفِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined; and the nominal clause هو الله is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ﴾ imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «he»; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or in the position of nominative as a second khabar. ﴿وَجَهْرَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to سركم. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ ما: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تكسبون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ويعلم is conjoined.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَما تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ما is negating. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. آية: a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of آية. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the verbal clause تأتيهم is resumptive, after the wāw. And the clause ﴿كانُوا عَنْها مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَمَّا جاءَهُمْ﴾ لما: an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; and the clause جاءهم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ سوف: a particle of futurity; يأتيهم: imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْباءُ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿ما كانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ ما: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause يستهزئون is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿أَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; يروا: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿كَمْ﴾ declarative (khabariyya), indicating abundance, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أهلكنا; and it has been said: interrogative, indeclinable on the sukūn. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. قرن: a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as the tamyīz (specification) of كم; and the clause كم أهلكنا stands in place of the two objects of يروا, or its single object if يروا is [the verb] of sight. ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; نا is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of قرن. ﴿ما لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَكُمْ﴾ ما: a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «We established them with some establishing»; and the better i'rab is that it is a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun): «We established them in the land with the establishing with which We have not established you». نمكن: imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, on the second view. ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا السَّماءَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِدْراراً﴾ أرسلنا: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun عليهم are attached; نا is its fāʿil and السماء its object; مدرارا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is conjoined to the clause مكناهم. ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَنْهارَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; and the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl if جعلنا takes one object, and in the position of accusative as a second direct object if it takes two objects. The clause ﴿فَأَهْلَكْناهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ﴾, and similarly the clause ﴿وَأَنْشَأْنا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْناً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿آخَرِينَ﴾ an adjective, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. لو: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَزَّلْنا عَلَيْكَ كِتاباً﴾ نزلنا: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil (agent) and كتابا its object. ﴿فِي قِرْطاسٍ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of كتاب. And the verbal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ لمسوه: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿نَزَّلْنا﴾. ﴿لَقالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ قال: past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), so the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the verbal clause كفروا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنْ هذا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ﴾ هذا سحر: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); إن is negating and إلا a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:8-8.t: In the verse there are two active verbs, with their fāʿils (agents), namely: قالوا and أنزلنا; and three passive verbs, with their nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent): أنزل ملك، قضي الأمر، ينظرون. The clause قالوا is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); the clause أنزل after it is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause أنزلنا is likewise resumptive. The clause لقضى is the response to لولا [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse that this clause answers is لو], with no grammatical position; and the clause ينظرون is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَلَوْ جَعَلْناهُ مَلَكاً﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. جعلنا: past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; نا is its fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ its first object and ملكا its second object; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). The clause ﴿لَجَعَلْناهُ رَجُلًا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلَلَبَسْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما يَلْبِسُونَ﴾ ما: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the verbal clause يلبسون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. The lām occurs in the response to an implied oath. قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ﴾ past verb, passive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of رسل; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَحاقَ بِالَّذِينَ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun بالذين are attached. ﴿سَخِرُوا﴾ past verb; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to سخروا. ﴿ما﴾ the relative noun, fāʿil (agent) of حاق. ﴿كانُوا بِهِ﴾ the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. And the preposition and its genitive noun به are attached to the verb يستهزئون.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and likewise ﴿ثُمَّ انْظُرُوا﴾; the clause سيروا is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause انظروا is conjoined. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of the verb كان. And ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ is its noun. ﴿الْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a masculine plural. And the clause ﴿كَيْفَ كانَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb انظروا.

daas-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وَهذا﴾ the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as a first adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مُبارَكٌ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿مُصَدِّقُ﴾ a third adjective. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرى﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl); the fāʿil is "you", umm is the mafʿūl bihi, and al-qurā is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, i.e. "and for warning the Mother of Towns". ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to umm. ﴿حَوْلَها﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ after it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿عَلى صَلاتِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb yuḥāfiẓūna after them, and the clause ﴿يُحافِظُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ hum; the nominal clause ﴿هم يحافظون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:93-93.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) aẓlam. ﴿افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; kadhiban is its object and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ قالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ﴾ a passive past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and shayʾ is its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ قالَ﴾ conjoined to mimman, i.e. "and than one who said". ﴿سَأُنْزِلُ مِثْلَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the sīn being for the future, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "Allah sent it down". ﴿وَلَوْ تَرى﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿إِذِ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time attached to the verb tarā. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative with wāw. ﴿فِي غَمَراتِ الْمَوْتِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the khabar of law [Translator's note: so in the source («وخبر لو»); what is meant is the answer (jawāb) of law] is omitted, the implied form being: "if you were to see them when the wrongdoers are in the throes of death, you would see a terrible thing". ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿باسِطُوا﴾ the khabar, nominative with wāw. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿أَخْرِجُوا أَنْفُسَكُمُ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. "saying to them". ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the verb tujzawna after it, or to the verb akhrijū before it. ﴿تُجْزَوْنَ عَذابَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil and ʿadhāb its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿الْهُونِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَقُولُونَ﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the incomplete verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "you are recompensed with the punishment of humiliation because of your saying". ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ﴾ ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَنْ آياتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb tastakbirūna, and the clause ﴿تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of the incomplete verb, and likewise the clause ﴿تَقُولُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:94-94.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتُمُونا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because of its connection with the vowelled tāʾ of the agent; the mīm is for the masculine plural, nā is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma. ﴿فُرادى﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition, mā is maṣdar-forming. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; nā is the fāʿil (agent), the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is for the plural. The interpreted maṣdar from maṣdar-forming mā and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "you have come to Us with a coming like Our creating you the first time". ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time attached to the verb before it. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَرَكْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn because of its connection with the tāʾ of the agent; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَوَّلْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, nā is its fāʿil and the kāf its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَراءَ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿ظُهُورِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما نَرى مَعَكُمْ شُفَعاءَكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the adverb after it is attached; its fāʿil is "we" and shufaʿāʾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿كَما خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿زَعَمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكاءُ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; anna and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of zaʿama. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the position of the answer to the implied oath; ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realization. ﴿تَقَطَّعَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is implied (muqaddar) as "the bond" (al-waṣl). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb taqaṭṭaʿa. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْكُمْ ما﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun is its object [Translator's note: so in the source («مفعوله»); mā here is the fāʿil of ḍalla]; the clause is conjoined.
﴿كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and the clause tazʿumūna is its khabar; the two objects of tazʿumūna are omitted, the implied form being: "what you used to claim to be intercessors has strayed from you".

daas-irab:95-95.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ فالِقُ الْحَبِّ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالنَّوى﴾ conjoined. ﴿يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and al-ḥayy is its object; the clause is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar. ﴿وَمُخْرِجُ﴾ conjoined to fāliq. ﴿الْمَيِّتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْحَيِّ﴾ the two are attached to the active participle mukhrij. ﴿ذلِكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty is the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition): "if Allah is the one who splits the grain and brings out the dead, then how are you turned away from worshipping Him?" ﴿أنى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, or it is resumptive.

daas-irab:96-96.t:
﴿فالِقُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "Allah is the one who splits…". ﴿الْإِصْباحِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَكَناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause. ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to al-layl. ﴿حُسْباناً﴾ the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "He made it a reckoning". ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَقْدِيرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَلِيمِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).
The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause ﴿فالِقُ الْإِصْباحِ﴾.

daas-irab:97-97.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, its khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّجُومَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and al-nujūm is its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِتَهْتَدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause (taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb jaʿala, i.e. "He made the stars for you for being guided by them". ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to tahtadū. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "that you may be guided by them, travelling in the darknesses of" ﴿الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ﴾. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿فَصَّلْنَا الْآياتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to faṣṣalnā. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause qad faṣṣalnā is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:98-98.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is latent and the kāf is its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "so for you there is a place of settlement". ﴿وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab in the previous verse.

daas-irab:99-99.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً﴾ the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ نَباتَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent) and nabāt its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا مِنْهُ خَضِراً﴾ the verbal clause is conjoined. ﴿نُخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُتَراكِباً﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is "we", ḥabban is its object and mutarākiban an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of khaḍiran. ﴿وَمِنَ النَّخْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the wāw is parenthetical. ﴿مِنْ طَلْعِها﴾ a badal (substitute) of al-nakhl, a substitute of part for whole. ﴿قِنْوانٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿دانِيَةٌ﴾ an adjective, and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, being parenthetical. ﴿وَجَنَّاتٍ﴾ conjoined to nabāt. ﴿مِنْ أَعْنابٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of jannāt. ﴿وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالرُّمَّانَ﴾ conjoined to jannāt. ﴿مُشْتَبِهاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَغَيْرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مُتَشابِهٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra. ﴿انْظُرُوا إِلى ثَمَرِهِ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to the verb before it; it is also permissible that idhā is conditional, its answer omitted, indicated by what precedes it; on both views the clause ﴿أَثْمَرَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَيَنْعِهِ﴾ conjoined to thamarihi. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of inna. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the noun of inna, accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa, [being] a sound feminine plural; the lām is the inceptive lām, for emphasis. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of āyāt. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of qawm, and the clause inna fī dhālikum is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:100-100.t:
